purpose: Post-freeze transfer evaluation on expert-annotated merger agreements materially distinct from CUAD clause extraction and ContractNLI NDA entailment.
development_prohibition: Do not inspect MAUD case contents to select V4.1 architecture, prompts, thresholds, weights, rules, retrieval settings or solver graphs.
Do not train or tune V4.1 on MAUD examples.
Do not choose an easy MAUD subset after seeing candidate outputs.
Any intentional development use of MAUD invalidates this seal and requires a different unseen transfer family.
opening_rule: Materialize and deterministically select the evaluation subset only after the complete V4.1 candidate artifact has been frozen by SHA-256.
minimum_transfer_requirement: The eventual MAUD result is an additional transfer gate; it cannot replace the locked CUAD/ContractNLI public gate, real-company evidence, human review or frontier head-to-head evidence.
claim_rule: No MAUD transfer claim exists until the post-freeze run is executed and its manifest/results are hashed.
